validation_scope: Exact parsed source spans/full rows, claim links, source identity, and company-disjoint splits; not semantic answer accuracy or exhaustive relevance.
coverage_counting: Year/company counts include each distinct source year/company once per question; comparative questions can contribute to several companies.
memory_policy: Stream each source document; retain only gold-selected element/table fields, then release them.

provenance.selection: 50 individually authored source-grounded questions: 20 factual (one per company), 15 two-company comparative and 15 bounded three-point summaries. No retrieval outputs or scores used.
limitations: Agent-curated draft, not manually human-labeled ground truth.
Canonical evidence is not exhaustive; equivalent unjudged passages may also answer correctly.
Summary answer points are a bounded rubric rather than an exhaustive disclosure list.
Comparative fiscal periods use reported company fiscal years, which can end on different dates.
Only development-company sources are used; test-company sources are excluded.

validation.year_column_and_units_review: Agent inspected original statement year headers and denomination context. Notes conventions for Deere and Costco are recorded per evidence unit.

provenance.selection: Individually authored by Codex after inspecting original parsed documents and native PDF text. No retrieval scores or ranked chunks consulted.
limitations: Agent-curated draft; user-requested independent human manual review is still pending.
Canonical evidence is not exhaustive; valid alternative answer locations may remain unjudged.
Readable native-text and accepted-table sources are overrepresented; not a complete scan/OCR stress test.
Cross-company fiscal years can have different end dates; those dates are explicitly disclosed.
provenance.freeze_rule: Freeze file hash before any test retrieval evaluation; do not tune or rewrite labels in response to test scores.
